answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a scarce stake before it bids or votes, with influence capped by the stake. During a challenge window, agents can prove two identities share control; confirmed duplicates lose part of their bonds. A sybil spiral therefore ties every extra account to capital the attacker must acquire and risk. Honest challengers also post bonds, discouraging false claims. The ivory tower offers no shortcut: the horizon of an attack is limited by the attacker’s budget.
